prompt:
Production-fidelity landscape desktop UI mockup, exact 16:9 first viewport only, of the D1 Desk login page as the category-standard centered SaaS login card done at full craft — NOT quirky, NOT experimental, NOT a full-bleed poster, NOT a terminal, NOT a connection dialog filling the screen. The arrangement every SaaS tool ships: calm light page ground with one soft floating login card centered in the viewport.

STRUCTURE (named regions, scale relationships):
1) PAGE GROUND (~100% viewport): calm flat light fill near #ffffff / very slight cool gray wash — quiet, empty, no illustration, no hero photo, no decorative pattern, no purple gradient. Soft even ambient so the card reads as the only focus.
2) CENTERED LOGIN CARD (~42% width, vertically and horizontally centered): clean white #ffffff soft card with subtle soft shadow, gentle rounded corners (~12–16px), generous internal padding. Flat fill surfaces, system sans (SF Pro / system UI grotesk — not Inter-as-display, not serif, not mono terminal). Materials: soft card, system sans, flat fill.
3) BRAND BLOCK (top of card, ~22% of card height): small simple mark or lettermark beside or above product name "D1 Desk" in #111827, medium-large system sans weight — brand first inside the card, not a giant full-page title. Optional tiny muted English kicker "Cloudflare Workspace" above the name in small caps/tracking, never louder than the name.
4) LEDE (under brand, ~12% of card): one short Chinese supporting sentence in muted gray: "账号级工作台：浏览 D1、KV、Workers，以及用 Email Routing 收发邮件。" Clear, product-true; names D1 / KV / Workers / 邮件 only.
5) TOKEN FIELD (middle of card, ~28% of card): label "API Token" in #111827; password-style input with soft border, placeholder "粘贴 Cloudflare API Token". Below: permission tip in small muted type — "建议权限：D1 Edit、Workers KV Storage Edit、Workers Scripts Read、Account Settings Read。" plus blue #2563eb text link "去创建 Token".
6) PRIMARY CTA (bottom of card): full-width flat-fill button in #2563eb with white Chinese label "进入工作台" — single primary action, idle state only (no spinner, no error banner, no account picker).

PALETTE exactly: #ffffff white, #111827 near-black ink, #2563eb blue accent for button and link. No cream+terracotta, no purple-indigo, no glow, no glassmorphism, no neon, no dark mode. Real Chinese product UI copy only from D1 Desk. High-resolution crisp desktop web UI mock of the page content area; no browser chrome clutter. Impeccable ordinary: the familiar centered login card executed perfectly.
